blocks.text: The DuckStation project published version Latest Preview Build on August 8, 2026. GitHub marks this entry as a pre-release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.
The official notes highlight the following changes: ee21478: GPU/HW: Don't miss updating read texture for recursive draws (Stenzek).
